profile.headline: Software Engineer at 3Play Media
profile.summary:
Full-stack web developer using my technical and professional skills to grow an exciting company in the web and video accessibility space.

Specialties: Ruby on Rails, JavaScript (React.js), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Resque, AWS Cognito

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Notable work while at 3Play:
* Lead developer / designer for Oracle Netsuite financial integration
* Lead developer for Hubspot marketing integration
* Core member of our Rails version upgrade team (4 --> 6)
* Migrated all user authentication to AWS Cognito and implemented SSO support via Cognito, reducing implementation time from weeks to hours
* Integrated a background check service through Turn Technologies

positions.title: Apprentice Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
* Immersive, full-time 10-week program preceded by 8 weeks of part-time work.
* Devoted 70+ hours/wk to learning JavaScript, Ruby, React, object oriented programming, test driven development, Git workflow, pair programming, and other coding fundamentals.
* 'SummerVelo' final project, an event tracking website, incorporates 3 outside APIs and numerous Ruby gems to allow cyclists to better schedule their upcoming season; maps and weather forecasting were integrated while maintaining responsiveness and minimizing load time.
* Collaborated with 3 classmates on 'Ruby On Trails', a two week group project that allows users to create accounts, add hiking trails, and leave and vote on reviews of each trail.

positions.title: Program Administrator
positions.description:
* Managed Advanced Study Program with 200+ professional education students annually.
* Increased program revenue 9%.
* Oversaw ~$100,000 annual budget for marketing campaigns, events, and other program expenses.
* Content owner and site manager for Advanced Study Program website (Drupal).
* Co-led project management of Salesforce & Pardot implementation for MIT Professional Education marketing team.

positions.title: Departmental Web Manager (Part Time)
positions.description:
* On-call web & graphic design management for Electrical & Computer Engineering department.
* Drupal, Adobe photoshop, & HTML

positions.title: Web Designer & Content Marketer
positions.description:
* Built entertainment website from ground up, reaching 20,000+ unique visitors.
* Achieved profitability in first month, with 79% ROI in last week.
* Implemented and tracked financial KPIs via Analytics and AdSense; optimized budgets, CPC, content & design, and managed 7+ ad campaigns with 4 different business partners and multiple ad channels.
* Wrote all site content and managed content creation and integration with on-site text and media.
* Researched, wrote, edited, and uploaded 100+ buying guides for (separate) main company website; scripted, produced, and managed video buying guides to ensure quality & brand compliance.
* Performed QA, bug-testing, SEO optimization, and social media brand advertising for other Roundforest products, including data solutions, eCommerce, engagement ring website, and company blog.

positions.title: Academic Administrative Assistant II
positions.description:
* Managed and updated complex FileMaker databases; compiled statistics, created grant reports.
* Supported Graduate admissions and recruitment, assisting in over 450 student visits and interviews.
* Maintained Drupal-based Biology Department website​ & ​assisted IT employees with departmental computing.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
* Developed and analyzed reporting metrics and department documentation for MA state government, MassHealth, and MBHP upper-management.
* Oversaw two departments for all office needs, calendar management, expense reporting, supplies & mailings, travel reimbursement, and basic IT services.
* Managed temporary employees, and ran production of large-scale events, such a 300+ person Law Enforcement & Mental Health Professionals conference and in-house meeting with patients.

positions.title: Office Assistant/Data Entry Specialist
positions.description: * Sensitive document processor in Ultra High Net Worth client department
